context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about budget compliance
purpose: Teach: 出願/支払っ/割り当て/閣議/即座/創立/書記/税理士

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、書記課で文書管理しています。
lines.en: This case is handled by the secretariat. Document management is their responsibility.
lines.style: Even, professional delivery. No rush. Sits comfortably with the statement—matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Steady eye contact, the confidence of someone who knows the system.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 閣議決定後の予算は、即座に各部署に割り当てされるんですか。
lines.en: After cabinet decisions, are budgets allocated to each section right away?
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful inquiry. Slight lean forward—genuinely interested, not just performing politeness. Measured pace. The tone of someone asking because they want to understand, not to challenge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。税理士との連携で、支払っ手続きまで一気通貫です。
lines.en: Yes. Through coordination with our tax accountant, the entire payment process runs seamlessly from start to finish.
lines.style: Assured, unhurried. Light emphasis on the continuity—「一気通貫」—as if showing something well-oiled. Warm but official. The tone of someone who trusts the system and is confident explaining it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 創立以来の慣例も残っているんですよね。
lines.en: Traditions from the founding era are still in place too, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft, perceptive probe. Not challenging—inviting confirmation. Slight upward inflection at the end like he's piecing things together out loud. Respectful of the continuity he's sensing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ええ。特許出願関連は、特に伝統的な様式を踏襲しています。
lines.en: That's right. Patent-related filings in particular—we maintain the traditional procedures quite strictly.
lines.style: Precise, measured. Slight warmth on acknowledging the question showed insight. No condescension. The tone of someone who respects that he's following the logic. Clear but not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強になりました。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: That was really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude without overdoing it. Slight nod in the voice. Warm but not effusive—the respect of a younger person for someone who gave real time and clear answers. Quiet sincerity.
